newsitem.title: CHINA: China cuts gold purchase price 5.0 yuan per gram.
newsitem.headline: China cuts gold purchase price 5.0 yuan per gram.

text.p: China recently cut the domestic gold purchase price by 5.0 yuan per gram, the China Gold newspaper said in its latest edition available in Beijing on Friday.
It did not give the actual purchase price.
It was the biggest adjustment to the price since September, 1993. China has adjusted prices twice previously, the newspaper said, but gave no details.

The move follows a slide in prices of the metal on international markets. Bullion stood at $355.00/50 per ounce on Friday in Hong Kong, up from New York's 354.10/60 close on Thursday but well below last year's $400 level.
The newspaper said the price reduction would have a significant impact on the domestic gold industry, which has been hit by a rise in production costs.
China produced 120.6 tonnes of gold last year, up from 108 tonnes 108 tonnes in 1995.
